name: Plantastic
detailed_description:
Item drop probability*:

  • Common - 85%

  • Uncommon - 11%

  • Rare - 3,5%

  • Epic - 0,5%

  • Legendary - 1 zu 250.000

*Subject to change

🌱 Plantastic – Grow plants. Grow trees. Grow good vibes. 🌿

Welcome to Plantastic, your charming little desktop companion where cute cartoon plants grow while you work – and where your time helps the real world grow greener, too!

✨ What is Plantastic?

Plantastic is a minimalist idle game that lives quietly on your screen while you do what you do best: work, study, chill, or click away. The more you interact with your PC, the more your plant grows – from seedling to fully bloomed show-off.

🌼 Features that help you blossom:

🌿 Collect 30+ plant types – from bashful daisies to diva cacti.
🎩 Unlock silly hats and accessories – party hats, sun visors, crowns, and more.
🎁 Get idle drops just by using your PC – no grinding, no pressure.
🧢 Mix & match looks to customize your leafy buddy’s style.
🪴 Relax and grow – no timers, no stress, just pure plant joy.

🌍 Virtual plants. Real trees.

Plantastic isn’t just about cozy vibes and aesthetic growth:

💚 95% of all revenue is donated to verified global reforestation programs.
🌲 For every plant you grow, we help plant a real tree.
🌎 Watch your impact grow – your own little forest, tracked live.

📦 Who is this for?

  • You want a cute companion that makes work feel a bit lighter

  • You’d love to support climate-positive actions with no extra effort

  • You enjoy collecting, customizing, and watching things flourish

🌻 Let's grow something beautiful – together.

Whether it’s a cactus with a cowboy hat or a lavender wearing shades – Plantastic is about joy, growth, and doing a little good while having fun.

🌱 Care for cute plants. Fund real trees.
🎉 Make it cozy. Make it Plantastic.
